text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You stretched waay out and plucked it 
right up~♪ Thank you, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, decorating your room with this will 
definitely boost your Umadol appeal! And 
also—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
From now on, you're going to push down the 
"Umadol Path" right along with me!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
So with that, I'll be in your care 
starting today! Let's start off by singing 
a duet together~☆
